$comment: The reference-drift-watch census record — the last known-good live census
of the base44 reference app's PUBLIC parity surfaces, measured with
agent-browser on 2026-10-06 (session 22) and re-verified by the instrument
run in the same session (GREEN). Session 23 re-verified P1-P4 GREEN
(14/14, the pre-audit cadence run), re-walked the four session-19
auth'd-state pins on the reference (login-renders-when-auth'd, the
auth-neutral chrome, the no-prefill book form, the auth'd 404), and
added the P5 login_shell block — the fifth public surface, measured
live with agent-browser the same session.
The instrument (scripts/reference-drift-watch.mjs) pins the browser clock
to `census_instant` and the context timezone to `timezone` before loading
each page, so every time-derived probe below is a DETERMINISTIC constant:
the pill's four-state text, the landing/services innerText lengths, and
the drawer's computed styles. Do not compare these values against an
unpinned clock — the pill reads the visitor's local time (the SP9/SP10
stance) and the innerText censuses include the pill text twice.
The login_shell block (P5) is NOT time-derived — the /login route renders
the sign-in card identically with or without auth (the session-19 pin) —
so its constants are plain computed-style reads. The input BACKGROUND is
deliberately excluded: bg-slate-50/50 serializes as rgba() under the
reference's Tailwind v3 but oklab() under the clone's v4 (the trap-7
class — pixels identical, strings engine-unstable); a string probe would
false-DRIFT on engine differences.
REMEDIATION PATH for intentional reference changes (a real platform
update): re-census the changed surface manually (agent-browser, the same
pins), update this record, review the diff, and commit — the same
convention docs/screenshots/ applies to an intentional pixel change.
